description: Mint a bearer token signed locally with this server's identity key, for clients that cannot sign requests: the hosted MCP server at https://sendforai.com/mcp, curl (Authorization: Bearer <token>), or no-code tools. Nothing is stored server-side; it expires after `days` (default 30, max 90). Treat it like a password.
name: create_connection_token
title: Create a connection token
